name: multi-workspace-for-notion

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --legal-comments=none --outfile=plugin/server.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.pack:mcpb: npm run build && npx -y @anthropic-ai/mcpb@2 pack . multi-workspace-for-notion.mcpb
scripts.check:bundle: npm run build && git diff --exit-code --stat plugin/server.mjs

description: Use several Notion workspaces at once from Claude Code and Claude Desktop, with the official Notion MCP tools
author: heoeunseo
